newsitem.title: USA: Holly sees Q3 on par or better than Q2.
newsitem.headline: Holly sees Q3 on par or better than Q2.

text.p: Holly Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it believed third quarter results would be the same or better than the second quarter.
It did not elaborate. It said financial results would be released in mid-February.
In the second quarter, ended September 30, the company reported a net income loss of $687,902 or $0.02 per share.

Holly also said its Navtech Industries Inc subsidiary had a "third successful quarter," completing a number of major projects, including in-room mini-bars for the Marriot International Inc's Marquis Hotel in New York City.
